description: Angular component for configuring timeseries processing settings within a rule node in the Thingsboard platform. Handles form initialization, validation, and configuration preparation for timeseries data processing strategies.

classes.name: TimeseriesConfigComponent
classes.description: Angular component extending RuleNodeConfigurationComponent to manage timeseries configuration form, including processing strategies, validation, and configuration transformation.

methods.name: configForm
methods.description: Returns the current timeseries configuration form group.

methods.name: validatorTriggers
methods.description: Specifies form fields that trigger validation updates.

methods.name: prepareInputConfig
methods.description: Prepares the input configuration form data based on existing configuration, setting defaults and processing settings.

methods.name: prepareOutputConfig
methods.description: Converts form data back into configuration format for output.

methods.name: onConfigurationSet
methods.description: Initializes the form with provided configuration data.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Enables or disables form controls based on current form state.
